Technical Documentation

Document check with 614 One

Pre-review of a German-language manual or technical document: 614 One looks for typical required content from DIN EN IEC/IEEE 82079-1 and CE rules, followed by an expert read-through.

  • Pre-review report with score, traffic light and to-do list
  • Report in English, German, Ukrainian or Russian
  • Every check point listed, with a recommendation

Fixed price per document
from €190 · 3 working days

From Requirements to Solutions

Four steps, clear decisions.

01 / 04

Understand.

First the problem, then the solution.

04 / 04

Every result traceable.
